name: com.opoi375.physics-simulation
description: A deterministic physics simulation toolkit for Unity: mass-spring systems solved with semi-implicit Euler and substepping, PBD cloth with wind and obstacles, soft bodies that turn any mesh into a volume-preserving jelly, collision proxies with Collider bridging, a real-solver model audit that grades arbitrary meshes, and PBF position-based fluids (dam breaks, pooling, instanced particle rendering) with uniform-hash neighbour search. No runtime dependencies beyond the test framework.
